audit_items.proof_trace: Line 178 unconditionally executes `self.cash_reserve = self.cash_reserve.add(math::float::from(protocol_seize_amount))`, satisfying the assertion for all non-ADL liquidations. For ADL paths (debt/collateral deleverage), `liquidation_revenue_factor` is explicitly set to `float::zero()`, making `protocol_seize_amount = 0` and leaving `cash_reserve` unchanged — the assertion `cash_reserve_after == cash_reserve_before + 0` holds trivially. No other operation in `liquidate_ctokens` modifies `cash_reserve` (verified: `withdraw_underlying` and `decrease_ctoken_supply` touch only `cash` and `total_supply`).
